_comment: Finale + warehouse automation (the Finale worker): Finale invoicing, ShipStation DSD close, dropship pre-fill. Split out of netsuite_customers.json 2026-09-21; still read through app.netsuite_payload.load_refs().
_comment_shipstation: ShipStation DSD close (app.shipstation, Ritchie 2026-09-16): DSD orders ship on HD trucks and never get a ShipStation label, so they sit in Awaiting Shipment/Awaiting Payment forever. When Finale shows the DSD shipment SHIPPED, the 15-min Finale poll marks the ShipStation order shipped (carrier 'other', tracking = the Finale shipment's tracking = the 6100 PRO, shipDate = Finale's ship date, notifyCustomer/notifySalesChannel false). Mark as Shipped does NOT fire the SHIP_NOTIFY webhook CRSTL builds ASNs from (proven 2026-09-16 on 31 orders). dsd_store_id = the 'HD DSD' store; go_live_after = positive floor on the ShipStation order's create date (history before it was cleaned by hand, or is left for review); max_per_run refuses a bigger run. enabled=false = dry runs only. Creds: SHIPSTATION_V1_KEY / SHIPSTATION_V1_SECRET in .env.
_comment_dropship_prefill: Dropship pre-fill (app.dropship, Ritchie 2026-09-17): the warehouse now clicks 'Ship shipment' in Finale at END OF DAY off what is packed, so the actual ship date is a human confirmation of a real pickup (Finale freezes that date at the ship action -- proven 2026-09-17). The Finale ShipStation connection's 'Pull Sales to Finale' warehouse row was set to 'Do not update stock levels', which stops it shipping AND stops it writing the tracking number; this pass writes tracking + carrier onto the still-PACKED shipment and ships nothing. Strict: writes only when the PO has exactly one live Finale shipment and one non-voided label, otherwise reports (skipped_ambiguous). store_id = the HD Dropship ShipStation store; go_live_after = floor on the label's create date; lookback_days bounds the labels read; carrier comes from finale.carriers.dropship. enabled=false = dry runs only.
_comment_finale: Finale invoice creation (app.finale_invoice) -- ONE tool invoices BOTH DSD and Dropship, EDI-driven (850 product/810 qty+price), exact CRSTL discount + our tax, auto-POSTED when it ties to the 810 to the cent, left as a DRAFT + flagged otherwise. Finale invoices go nowhere downstream (internal record for teams without NetSuite). Ids read from the Finale catalogue 2026-09-15 (GET /api/productpromo, /api/taxauthorityrateproduct): promo presets DSD 100037 'DSD - 6.18875%', Dropship 100038 'Dropship - 5.18875%'; tax-rate products GST 5%=100000 (AB/BC/MB: we bill GST-only, no PST), HST 15%=100001 (NB/NL/PE), HST 13%=100002 (ON), GST+QST=100003 (QC), HST 14%=100004 (NS); SK uses GST 5%=100000 since 2026-09-22 (HD is PST-exempt on resale -- CMP doc p.13/p.23); GST+Sask PST=100005 is no longer mapped. enabled=false ships it OFF; the scheduled path is also capped by max_per_run and only ever invoices what the NetSuite push just sent.

finale._comment_nonedi: Non-EDI sale orders (HD Supply, Home Depot Special Orders, Chandos, Cressey, future OMIS commercial...) have no Crstl 850/810; accounting runs elsewhere (OMIS->NetSuite). app.finale_nonedi invoices them in Finale from the ORDER's own lines when SHIPPED in Finale, tax by the customer party's postal-address province, no discount, then completes the order. Classified by EXCLUSION (order id not a Crstl PO and saleSource not an EDI source) -- no customer list to maintain. nonedi_go_live_after is the floor on the Finale order date.
finale._comment_carriers: Carrier defaults per EDI channel (Ritchie, 2026-09-16): the ShipStation connection ships dropship shipments with NO carrier and the warehouse had to reopen/edit/re-complete each order to set Purolator; DSD pickups are keyed HDOC by hand. Names are matched exactly against Finale's Carriers list (Settings > Carriers, GET /api/partygroup groupName). ONLY the two EDI passes apply them -- DSD: written with PRO/RTS onto the open shipment before pickup; dropship (and DSD as fallback): written inside the invoice pass, in the reopen the engine already does. Non-EDI orders (HD Supply, Special Orders, ...) ship via a carrier TBD and are never touched. enabled=false ships it OFF: dry runs show which shipments would get which carrier; flip it after reviewing that list.
finale._comment_dsd_order_fields: DSD bill of lading (Ritchie, 2026-09-16): the BOL template can print sales-order custom fields ({{order.userFieldData.user_NNNNN}}) but NOT shipment notes, so the RTS goes into the order's 'RTS' custom field (Settings > Selling > Sales order custom fields: RTS = user_10000 gets the 3200 bill-of-lading number, 'Routing' = user_10002 gets the 6100 routing number, Seal = user_10001 is typed at print time via a named parameter and never by the app). Both order fields are needed because the bill of lading can only read order custom fields and the shipment's trackingCode -- shipment publicNotes has no template variable, and since 2026-09-17 trackingCode holds the RTS, so the routing number had nowhere else to go. Written by the DSD pass with PRO/carrier; the RTS ALSO stays in the shipment's public notes so the shipment page shows it (shipments have no custom fields). Finale only accepts order field writes in the edit state: the pass does edit -> write -> lock on a LOCKED order (the same cycle the ShipStation connection and the warehouse already do on open DSD orders) and writes directly on a CREATED one; a COMPLETED/CANCELLED order is never touched. The list is REPLACED on write, so the pass resends every existing entry (the ShipStation connection's hash) plus ours. enabled=false = dry runs only.
finale._comment_dsd_prefill: DSD pickups (2026-09-15): switched on/off from the dashboard Automation panel (setting auto_dsd_prefill_enabled, default off), not here. When on, the 15-min job copies the RTS (bill_of_lading_number, 3200... -> shipment trackingCode AND the order's RTS custom field) and the routing number (carrier_reference_number, 6100... -> shipment publicNotes 'Routing: ...') -- which is which per the warehouse, 2026-09-16, and 'RTS IS tracking' 2026-09-17 from each newly Accepted DSD 856 (Crstl flavor 'Direct Store Delivery (DSD)') onto the open Finale shipment of that PO, so the warehouse only types them once (in the ASN). The warehouse's manual 'Ship shipment' click at pickup stays -- it is the pickup confirmation. Same go_live_after floor, created_within_days window and max_per_run cap; one receipt per ASN (finale_shipments). Not reported in the digest.
finale._comment_auto_reopen: Ritchie's rule (2026-09-15): an order marked complete with no shipment or invoice is NOT complete. When true, the engines reopen such an order (edit -> lock, via its own action URLs) before invoicing; if it is still unshipped it stays open for the warehouse and is retried. false = report would_reopen in previews only.
finale._comment_stale_pickup: Digest Issues: an Accepted 810 still not shipped in Finale this many days after acceptance (DSD pickups always ship within 7 days; over 4 is trouble).
finale._comment_go_live_after: Finale's OWN positive floor (created_at, per the shared automation guard): the poll never considers an 810 created before this date, so enabling Finale invoicing only ever touches orders from this date forward -- history the warehouse invoiced by hand is out of scope by construction, not just by the existing-invoice skip.
